rabbitmq.missing_queue_attach: by design: ramqp-broker auto-declares a transient queue for an undeclared /queues/<name> (RabbitMQ 4.x requires a declared queue)

artemis.unsettled_close_redelivers: Artemis does not count a delivery lost with its consumer in delivery-count; ramqp-broker follows RabbitMQ 4.x (it does, #54)
artemis.first_acquirer: Artemis never sets first-acquirer; ramqp-broker follows RabbitMQ 4.x (true on a first delivery, #54)
